title: Istio flashcards: for the Istio Certified Associate (ICA) exam
releaseBlockers: check version-dependent cards against Istio 1.26, the version the exam targets
description: Istio: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.

glossary.CA: certificate authority, which signs and issues certificates
glossary.L3: layer 3 of the network stack, where IP addresses route packets
glossary.L4: layer 4 of the network stack, the transport layer (TCP connections)
glossary.L7: layer 7 of the network stack, the application layer (for example HTTP requests)
glossary.mTLS: mutual TLS, where both sides present certificates
glossary.TLS: Transport Layer Security, the encryption used by HTTPS
glossary.HTTP: Hypertext Transfer Protocol, the protocol of web requests
glossary.SNI: Server Name Indication, the host name a client sends at the start of TLS

sourceShort: the Istio documentation and the CNCF curriculum

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 512 cards against the Istio documentation they quote, word for word as found by the card checker
checks.result: 1 wrong answer (how two ORed authorisation rules combine), 2 unsupported claims, 2 ambiguous cards, 6 unclear ones and 8 minor issues were fixed; the wrong card was rechecked against its source, and a page saved incompletely was saved again and its card re-quoted.
